svg.title: Становая тяга с дефицита — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Deficit deadlift, side three-quarter view. The athlete stands with BOTH SHOES on the same broad very shallow rectangular rigid step (about five centimeters high) on gym floor in BOTH phases. A standard loaded barbell lies directly on LOWER gym floor in front of the step at start, both plates touch gym floor, bar BELOW athlete's raised foot level difference is visually clear. LEFT: hinged hips and bent knees, neutral back, athlete grips bar on floor. RIGHT: standing tall on the same step, bar at thighs, straight arms, plates airborne. Do not put any blocks under the weight plates. Entire shallow step, shoes and barbell visible. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
